rows.grounds: legacy hint remembered; parsed as niḥ + smṛta, hence not-remembered

items.question: What is said to be auspicious-giving and forgotten in the Āgamāmṛta?
items.inference: The verse states something forgotten and auspicious-giving in the Āgamāmṛta.
uncertainties: The exact referent of niḥsmṛtaṃ is not specified in this excerpt.
items.plain_english: And [it is] forgotten, O great goddess, auspicious-giving, in the Āgamāmṛta.
